college.name: JNTU-GV College of Engineering Vizianagaram (JNTU-GV CEV)
college.type: Constituent University College of JNTU Gurajada Vizianagaram
college.overview: JNTU-GV College of Engineering Vizianagaram is a premier autonomous university engineering college in North Coastal Andhra Pradesh. Known for technical excellence, state-of-the-art research laboratories, vibrant student culture, and strong placement records.

alumni.description: JNTU-GV maintains an active alumni network connecting current students with graduates globally. The dedicated Alumni Portal allows alumni to register, share mentorship, interact with departments, and engage in campus events.
alumni.benefits: Networking opportunities, mentorship programs, career guidance, industry connections, campus event participation, and lifelong community membership.
alumni.how_to_connect: Visit https://alumni.jntugv.edu.in to register, update profile, connect with fellow alumni, and access exclusive resources.

stories_and_experiences.title: Life at JNTU-GV Vizianagaram Campus
stories_and_experiences.content: Life at JNTU-GV CEV combines rigorous technical education with an energetic student community. Spread across a sprawling 100-acre green campus in Dwarapudi, Vizianagaram, students participate in annual technical fests, inter-college sports tournaments, coding hackathons, cultural nights, and community outreach programs through NSS.

stories_and_experiences.title: Student Innovations and R&D Projects
stories_and_experiences.content: Undergraduate and postgraduate students at JNTU-GV CEV regularly work on cutting-edge research projects sponsored by DST, AICTE, and MSME. Recent achievements include AI-based smart agriculture monitoring systems, autonomous solar-powered water purification units, IoT smart grid controllers, and deep-learning medical diagnostic tools.

stories_and_experiences.title: Placement Success Stories
stories_and_experiences.content: JNTU-GV CEV boasts a high placement record with packages reaching up to 42 LPA. Top recruiters include TCS, Wipro, Infosys, Accenture, Cognizant, L&T, Hexaware, and Tech Mahindra. The dedicated Training & Placement Officer (TPO) conducts mock interviews, aptitude training, soft skills workshops, and coding bootcamps starting from 3rd year.

stories_and_experiences.title: Alumni Network & Community
stories_and_experiences.content: JNTU-GV maintains an active network connecting current students with alumni globally. The dedicated Alumni Portal at https://alumni.jntugv.edu.in allows alumni to register, share mentorship, interact with departments, and engage in campus events. Over 5,000+ alumni are connected through this platform, providing mentorship, job referrals, and industry collaborations.

departments_detailed.name: Computer Science & Engineering
departments_detailed.highlights: Advanced AI/ML labs, High-performance computing center, active IEEE and CSI chapters, competitive programming clubs.

departments_detailed.name: Electronics & Communication Engineering
departments_detailed.highlights: VLSI design lab, Embedded Systems & IoT center, Signal Processing unit, antenna wave propagation labs.

departments_detailed.name: Electrical & Electronics Engineering
departments_detailed.highlights: High Voltage Lab, Power Systems Simulator, Renewable Energy Research Center (Solar & Wind Energy).

departments_detailed.name: Mechanical Engineering
departments_detailed.highlights: CAD/CAM Simulation Center, Thermal Engineering Lab, Robotics & Automation Lab, Workshop & CNC Machining.

departments_detailed.name: Metallurgical Engineering
departments_detailed.highlights: Materials Characterisation Lab, Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) facilities, Foundry & Heat Treatment workshops.

departments_detailed.name: Information Technology
departments_detailed.highlights: Cloud Computing Lab, Cybersecurity & Digital Forensics, Data Science & Analytics Research Lab.

departments_detailed.name: Basic Sciences & Humanities
departments_detailed.highlights: Phonics & Language Communication Skills Lab, Physics & Chemistry Research Labs, Engineering Mathematics unit.

departments_detailed.name: Master of Business Administration
departments_detailed.hod: Dr. K. V. S. M. Ramanesh
departments_detailed.highlights: Finance, HR, Marketing, Operations specialisations, Management Fests, Entrepreneurship Cell integration.

facilities.hostels: Separate modern hostels for Boys and Girls on campus with 24/7 security, Wi-Fi connectivity, RO drinking water, hygienic mess dining hall, indoor games, and reading rooms.
facilities.library: Central Library housing over 45,000+ volumes, IEEE/ASME digital journals, DELNET e-resources, spacious reading halls, and quiet study zones.
facilities.sports: Full-size cricket ground, football field, basketball court, volleyball courts, badminton courts, indoor games hall (table tennis, chess), and modern fitness gymnasium.
facilities.dispensary: On-campus health center with qualified resident doctor, staff nurse, essential medicine dispensary, and emergency ambulance service available 24x7.
facilities.transport: College bus fleet providing daily commute services across Vizianagaram town, railway station, and nearby routes.

regulations_summary.R20: Regulation 2020: Choice Based Credit System (CBCS), 160 credits total for B.Tech, 4-year duration, mandatory 10-week summer internships, minor & honors degree options.
regulations_summary.R23: Regulation 2023: Outcome Based Education (OBE) aligned with NEP 2020, skill-oriented courses, community service projects in 1st/2nd year, industry internships in final year.
regulations_summary.R25: Regulation 2025: Latest revised curriculum with AI & Data Science integration across all branches, multidisciplinary electives, project-based learning.

faqs.question: How to get admission into JNTU-GV CEV B.Tech?
faqs.answer: Admissions for B.Tech are conducted through AP EAMCET / EAPCET counselling based on rank. Lateral entry for Diploma holders is through AP ECET.

faqs.question: Who is the Principal of JNTU-GV CEV?
faqs.answer: Dr. V. S. Vakula is the Principal of JNTU-GV College of Engineering Vizianagaram.

faqs.question: Where is JNTU-GV College located and how to reach?
faqs.answer: The college is located at Dwarapudi, Vizianagaram (535003). It is about 7 km from Vizianagaram Railway Station and Complex Bus Stand. Auto rickshaws and college buses are readily available.

faqs.question: What is the highest placement package at JNTU-GV CEV?
faqs.answer: The highest package recorded is 42 LPA, with average packages ranging between 4.5 to 7 LPA across CSE, ECE, IT, EEE, Mechanical, and Metallurgy.

faqs.question: What is the URL for the Alumni Portal?
faqs.answer: The official JNTU-GV Alumni Portal is available at https://alumni.jntugv.edu.in.
